title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: This course introduces the foundational concepts of Artificial Intelligence. Topics include search techniques, heuristics, adversarial search (game playing), constraint satisfaction, knowledge representation, first-order logic, and classical planning. Students will learn the history of AI and implement search algorithms in Python.
syllabus: Introduction to AI and Intelligent Agents
Uninformed Search Strategies (BFS, DFS, Uniform Cost Search)

title: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: An introduction to machine learning theory and practice. The course covers supervised learning (linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, support vector machines, k-nearest neighbors) and unsupervised learning (k-means clustering, PCA). Students will use Python and standard libraries like Scikit-Learn and Pandas to build and evaluate models.
syllabus: Introduction to Supervised and Unsupervised Learning

title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
description: Advanced course focusing on deep neural architectures. Topics include multi-layer perceptrons, backpropagation, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for image processing, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and LSTMs for sequential data, and generative adversarial networks (GANs). Students will implement deep networks using PyTorch.
syllabus: Introduction to Deep Learning and Perceptrons
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for Computer Vision
Introduction to PyTorch and Tensor Operations

title: Natural Language Processing
description: This course covers algorithms and models for parsing, understanding, and generating natural language. Topics include word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe), part-of-speech tagging, sequence-to-sequence models, attention mechanisms, and modern transformers (BERT, GPT). Practical work will involve HuggingFace and NLTK in Python.

title: Computer Vision
description: An introduction to processing and analyzing digital images. The course covers image filtering, edge detection, feature extraction (SIFT, HOG), camera calibration, image classification, object detection (YOLO, SSD), and semantic segmentation. Practical assignments are implemented in Python using OpenCV and PyTorch.
syllabus: Image Basics and Digital Image Representation
Image Filtering, Smoothing, and Edge Detection (Canny)
Feature Extraction and Matching (SIFT, SURF, ORB)
Convolutional Neural Networks for Image Classification

title: Data Engineering & Infrastructure
description: A course covering the principles and practices of building scalable data systems. Topics include relational databases (SQL), NoSQL databases, data pipelines, ETL processes, and big data computing tools like Apache Spark and Hadoop. Students will learn how to design data architectures that support machine learning pipelines.
syllabus: Relational Database Design and Complex SQL Queries
Large-scale Data Processing with Apache Spark

title: Advanced Python & Software Engineering
description: This course covers software engineering principles with Python. Topics include object-oriented programming (OOP), design patterns, unit testing, version control with Git, containerization using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable code. Students will build full-stack web applications.
syllabus: Advanced Python Concepts (Generators, Decorators, Context Managers)
Version Control with Git and GitHub

title: Cloud Computing & DevOps
description: Comprehensive course on cloud platforms and DevOps practices. Covers AWS, Azure, and GCP services, container orchestration with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), monitoring and logging, and cloud security best practices.
syllabus: Introduction to Cloud Computing and Service Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC)
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and CloudFormation
CI/CD Pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI
Configuration Management with Ansible and Chef
Monitoring and Logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)
Cloud Security and Compliance Best Practices

title: Data Analytics & Visualization
description: Course focused on data analysis techniques and visualization tools. Covers statistical analysis, data cleaning and transformation, SQL for data analysis, Excel for business analytics, and visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI. Students will learn to derive insights from data and create compelling dashboards.
syllabus: Introduction to Data Analytics and the Data Analysis Lifecycle
Advanced SQL for Data Analysis (Window Functions, CTEs, Subqueries)
Excel for Business Analytics (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros)
Data Visualization Principles and Best Practices
Power BI for Business Intelligence and Reporting

title: Full Stack Web Development
description: Complete full-stack web development course. Covers front-end development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Angular, back-end development with Node.js and Python, database integration (SQL and NoSQL), RESTful API design, authentication, and deployment strategies.
syllabus: Backend Development with Node.js and Express
Database Design: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)

title: Mobile Application Development
description: Course on mobile app development for iOS and Android platforms. Covers native development with Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android), cross-platform development with React Native and Flutter, mobile UI/UX design, app architecture patterns, and app store deployment.
syllabus: Mobile Development Fundamentals and Platform Overview
iOS Development with Swift and SwiftUI
Android Development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

title: Database Management Systems
description: Comprehensive course on database design, implementation, and management. Covers relational database theory, SQL programming, NoSQL databases, database normalization, transaction management, indexing, query optimization, and distributed databases.
syllabus: Relational Database Design and ER Modeling
NoSQL Databases: Document (MongoDB), Key-Value, Column-Family, Graph
Distributed Databases and Big Data Storage

title: Algorithms & Data Structures
description: Fundamental course on algorithms and data structures. Covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting algorithms, searching algorithms, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and algorithm complexity analysis.
syllabus: Introduction to Algorithms and Complexity Analysis (Big O)
Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, and Queues
Graphs and Graph Algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra)
Sorting Algorithms (Merge Sort, Quick Sort, Heap Sort)

title: MLOps & Machine Learning Engineering
description: Advanced course on Machine Learning Operations. Covers ML model lifecycle management, model deployment and serving, ML pipelines (Apache Airflow, Kubeflow), model monitoring and drift detection, A/B testing for ML models, feature stores, and scalable ML infrastructure.
syllabus: Introduction to MLOps and ML Engineering
Model Deployment and Serving (TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe)
Building ML Pipelines with Apache Airflow and Kubeflow
A/B Testing for Machine Learning Models
Scalable ML Infrastructure on Cloud Platforms

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Introduction to cybersecurity principles and practices. Covers network security, cryptography, secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing basics, security compliance, and incident response.
syllabus: Introduction to Cybersecurity and Security Principles
Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing Basics
Security Architecture and Defense in Depth

title: Reinforcement Learning
description: Advanced course on reinforcement learning algorithms. Covers Markov Decision Processes, Q-Learning, Deep Q-Networks, Policy Gradients, Actor-Critic methods, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and applications in robotics, gaming, and finance.
syllabus: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning and MDPs
Markov Decision Processes and Bellman Equations
Actor-Critic Algorithms and Proximal Policy Optimization
Applications in Robotics, Gaming, and Finance
Advanced Topics: Hierarchical RL and Meta-RL

title: Big Data & Distributed Computing
description: Course on big data technologies and distributed computing. Covers Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, MapReduce, YARN), Apache Spark for big data processing, stream processing with Kafka and Flink, data warehousing with Hive, and distributed database systems.
syllabus: Introduction to Big Data and Distributed Computing
Hadoop Ecosystem: HDFS, MapReduce, and YARN
Stream Processing with Apache Kafka and Apache Flink
Big Data Processing Patterns and Optimization
Cloud-Based Big Data Services (AWS EMR, Google Dataproc)

title: Generative AI & Prompt Engineering
description: An applied introduction to generative models, prompt engineering, and production considerations for LLM-driven systems. Students learn prompt design, prompt tuning, safety, evaluation, and tools for working with large language models.
syllabus: Introduction to Generative Models and LLMs
Hands-on Projects: Chatbots, Summarization, Code Generation

title: Applied GenAI Systems
description: Engineering and deploying GenAI systems at scale. Covers retrieval systems, vector databases, prompt orchestration, latency optimization, cost control, and observability for LLM services.
syllabus: Embedding Models and Vector Databases (Milvus, Pinecone)
Monitoring, Logging, and Observability for LLMs
Case Studies: Assistants, Summarizers, Code Helpers

title: LLM Systems & Scaling
description: Systems-level course on infrastructure for large language models: model serving, batching, sharding, GPU orchestration, model parallelism, and cost-efficient inference.
syllabus: Serving at Low Latency and High Throughput

title: Ethics, Governance, and Responsible AI
description: Explores ethical, legal, and governance issues in AI, including fairness, transparency, privacy, and regulation. Practical frameworks for responsible AI development are discussed.

title: Advanced NLP with Transformers
description: In-depth study of transformer architectures and applications in NLP: fine-tuning, transfer learning, multilingual models, and evaluation for production systems.

title: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
description: Covers statistical and machine learning methods for time series forecasting including ARIMA, state-space models, and deep learning approaches.
syllabus: Deep Learning for Time Series (RNNs, LSTMs)

title: Graph Machine Learning
description: Introduction to graph-structured data and models: graph embeddings, GNNs, node classification, and link prediction for knowledge graphs and social networks.
syllabus: Applications: Knowledge Graphs and Social Networks

title: Statistical Learning
description: Covers foundational statistical learning methods, regularization, generalized linear models, and statistical inference for predictive modeling.

title: Optimization Methods for Machine Learning
description: Focus on optimization techniques used in ML: convex optimization, stochastic gradient methods, second-order methods, and practical optimization for deep learning.
